newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA REPLACES TWO PLAYERS FROM NZ SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA REPLACES TWO PLAYERS FROM NZ SQUAD.

text.p: Sri Lanka will send two one-day specialist players to New Zealand to be included in the squad for the three one-day internationals starting on March 22, a Cricket Board official said on Wednesday.
All-rounders Ruwan Kalpage and Upul Chandana will leave Sri Lanka on Wednesday to join the team at Hamilton, Dammika Ranatunga, chief executive of the Board of Control for Cricket, told Reuters.
The two players will replace batsman Duleep Samaraweera and fast-medium pace bowler Promodya Wickremasinghe, who will return to Sri Lanka, Ranatunga said.
He said the move was not in response to Sri Lanka's innings defeat to New Zealand in the first test match concluded in Dunedin on Monday.
The second and final test will begin on Friday at Hamilton.
"(Kalpage and Chandana) will play only in the one-day games," Ranatunga said. "But if they arrive on time and if the management feels they should play in the test match, then they can."
Sri Lanka and New Zealand will play three one-day internationals scheduled for March 22, 25 and 27.
